$comment: Each entry becomes one voting card.
id        - stable slug, used as the primary key. Changing it creates a NEW candidate.
name      - the single name sentence shown under the image.
imageUrl  - absolute URL to the candidate's image.
sortOrder - tie-breaker ordering on both the voting grid and the results page.
Re-running the seed upserts by id: names and images update, existing votes are kept.

Pin a TAG or commit SHA, never a branch. jsDelivr caches tags and SHAs for a
year; a branch URL is cached for only 12 hours, so it both re-fetches
constantly and can serve a stale image for half a day after you update it.
